name: kweli-mcp
description: The Kweli MCP — every Kweli function in one WorkOS-OAuth-gated server: graph reads (kweli_search_places, kweli_get_place, kweli_get_organization, kweli_get_verification, kweli_get_open_stats), ingestion inspection, and place generation (kweli_seed_region, kweli_seed_admin_bulk, kweli_request_place), served by the official MCP SDK v2 as stateless Streamable HTTP. Generation tools forward to the independent bulk-place-agent / single-place-agent Workers over WorkOS M2M, exactly as any other Nyuchi/Mukoko app would.
